description: Görlitz Rail Test Center CV Dataset 2024 (RailGoerl24) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. RailGoerl24 is an on-board visual light Full-HD camera dataset consisting of 12,205 frames and 383,922,305 off-board LiDAR colored cloud points recorded in a railway test center of TÜV SÜD Rail, in Görlitz, Germany, on April 24th, 2024. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are autonomous-rail-transit-art, autonomous-vehicle-av, fid-move, object-detection, railway. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
